- Actions (Clinician/GP):

Secondary Problem: Work-related Stress
- Patient Goal(s):

- Clinical Goal(s):

- Actions (Patient):

    - Implement strategies for workload management (as discussed)
- Actions (Clinician/GP):

    - Offer self-referral counseling resources
